meta.name: So I Married An Anti Fan 1080p
meta.description:
The romance between top star Hoo Joon and his anti-fan reporter Lee Geun-young who end up living together.

Ended · First aired 30 Apr 2021 · South Korea · Language: Korean · 60 min
Studio: Godin Media, Warner Bros. Television · Network: Viki, NAVER TV

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

On your server — Audio: Korean

videos.title: How Could Anyone Be This Different from Me?
videos.overview: Kpop artist Who Joon comes back to Korea and almost immediately makes a bad impression on journalist Geun-young and her life.

videos.title: Are You Brave Enough to Be Hated?
videos.overview: Geun-young embraces her new anti-fan status but starts to regret being so easily recognized. Who Joon is irritated by Geun-young's antics and the inconvenience that she is causing him.

videos.title: Reality, Something Between Somewhat and Somehow
videos.overview: Geun-young and Who Joon do their first shoot together and things take a dramatic turn when they get into an accident. Who Joon and JJ get into an argument over In-hyung and Geun-young.

videos.title: You and I... It's An Incident Or An Accident?
videos.overview: Geun-young makes a mistake on set and goes to find Who Joon to apologize only to see In-hyung again but still unable to see who she is. Who Joon tries to distance himself from JJ and In-hyung but somehow gets dragged back in.

videos.title: Where I Belong and Where I Don’t
videos.overview: After meeting Roy and seeing her portrayal in the trailer of the show, Geun-young starts to look for a job second-guessing signing on to the show. Who Joon runs into JJ and the two end up getting into a physical fight.

videos.title: If I Had Never Met You
videos.overview: The reality show moves to Japan because Who Joon has a commercial shoot there. Who Joon and JJ both find out that In-hyung is to co-star in the commercial causing more friction between them that spills out and gets noticed by Geun-young.

videos.title: You Make Me Worry...
videos.overview: After returning from Japan, Geun-young realizes that being on a reality show is hard work. Geun-young also starts to put together Who Joon and In-hyung's past relationship.

videos.title: What Doesn't Fit You Always Becomes a Problem
videos.overview: Who Joon and Geun-young start to warm up to each other, but Who Joon's past complicates things. JJ's inability to let Who Joon go creates more problems for Who Joon.

videos.title: The Two Just Can't Ever Get Close
videos.overview: Who Joon tries to mend his relationship with Geun-young even though Geun-young misunderstands his motives. JJ continues to investigate Who Joon and runs into a clue accidentally given to him by Geun-young.

videos.title: When You Have Someone Else To Protect
videos.overview: Who Joon finds out about Yu-ri and decides to go on a road trip with her and Geun-young. JJ and In-hyung's relationship gets more complicated after the interview with Who Joon.

videos.title: Sometimes You Have to Pick Your Side
videos.overview: Who Joon rushes to the hospital with Geun-young to see In-hyung. Geun-young stays the night with In-hyung to make sure that she is recovering. Who Joon gets kidnapped by a fan, and Geun-young and Ji-hyang try to find him.

videos.title: Was It Twist of Fate That Brought Us Here?
videos.overview: Who Joon and Geun-young grow closer and define their relationship though they are keeping it a secret. In-hyung starts to move on from JJ and realizes she has more people on her side than she thought.

videos.title: A Dangerous Invitation
videos.overview: While the rumors about Who Joon and In-hyung persist, JJ shares new information about Who Joon with Young-seok, hoping that Young-seok will come to his side. Who Joon and Geun-young go to the beach to shoot for their show.

videos.title: This Won't Be The End
videos.overview: With their show ending, Geun-young and Who Joon navigate the new phase of their relationship only to be hit by two different scandals consecutively. The outcome has far-reaching effects that lead to tragedy and the end of relationships.

videos.title: The Truth Untold
videos.overview: Overwhelmed with the fallout from his press conference, the accident, and trying to find his father, Who Joon decides to take a step back. Geun-young gives him space while trying to help him using the media.

videos.title: I'll Stand by You Until the End of Time
videos.overview: In-hyung and JJ are recovering in the hospital after their and each reflects on their past relationships and mistakes. Geun-young and Who Joon focus on their careers and relationship, hoping to leave their problems behind.
